summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on the Jonga, a vehicle designed by Nissan and used by the Indian Army. It also explains that the name Jonga is an acronym for Jabalpur Ordnance aNd Guncarriage Assembly, the name of the Jabalpur-based assembly that is tied to the vehicle's name.
one_line: The Jonga was a Nissan-designed vehicle used by the Indian Army, named after the Jabalpur Ordnance and Guncarriage Assembly.
key_facts: The Jonga was a vehicle designed by Nissan.
The Jonga was used by the Indian Army.
Jonga stands for Jabalpur Ordnance aNd Guncarriage Assembly.
The Jabalpur Ordnance aNd Guncarriage Assembly is the source of the name Jonga.
